rubric_items.reason: Everything is built on existing layers (router, service, repo, client.ts, PatientsPage). It adds no new endpoint, migration or infrastructure, and it follows the UTC/HOSPITAL_TZ and list-envelope rules.

S-1 to S-4 are each mapped to components. Every acceptance criterion (latest COMPLETED, Asia/Kolkata date, '-' for null, unchanged paging/search/sort/Next, no sort option, no medical columns) is covered.
The endpoint method and path are exact. But the new response field has no name, no type literal and no date format, and the HOSPITAL_TZ query parameter shape is not given.
Most choices cite context. The PatientListItem types in api/src/types.ts and web/src/api/types.ts are not in the module map and have no citation, yet they are listed as changed and Assumed says None.
The non-obvious choices (DB vs browser date, derived vs stored column, reusing the endpoint, selecting only the date) each have a reason and a cost.
Clear and well organised. Minor inconsistency: the endpoints are listed as items under Components in the body but not in the frontmatter components list.

findings.text: The new response field is never named, typed or formatted (for example last_visit: string | null, YYYY-MM-DD). The api and web types must match, and S-1 AC3 needs an exact date format to test at API level.

cites.quote: Adds a nullable last-visit date field.

findings.suggested_fix: Give the exact JSON field name, its TS type in both types.ts files, and the date string format, for example "last_visit": "2026-10-14" | null.
